## What this site is

- **FractiAI / Vibelandia** — transmedia, Reno-first experiences, HH Awareness AI OS upgrade path (SING! 9), StoryStream, games, and protocols in-repo.
- **Lite edges** — wallets, keys, verifications at the edge; center = pipes only (see SING9_EDGE_ONBOARDING.md).
